method_evidence_tiers.M0_AUTHOR_SOURCE: Author-released executable source and, where applicable, author-released learned state.
method_evidence_tiers.M1_PAPER_COMPLETE: A clean-room implementation uniquely specified by the paper and supplement.
method_evidence_tiers.M2_CITATION_PREDECESSOR: Missing choices are completed from explicitly cited methods, author-linked predecessor code, or documented direct lineage.
method_evidence_tiers.M3_DECLARED_COMPLETION: Remaining choices are completed by registered engineering decisions with alternatives and sensitivity obligations.
method_evidence_tiers.M4_FORMULA_FIXTURE: Equation or operator fixtures only; no optimization-quality or original-method claim.

problem_evidence_tiers.P1_PAPER_COMPLETE: The paper and supplement uniquely define every numerical input affecting objective or feasibility.
problem_evidence_tiers.P2_CITATION_SAME_AUTHOR: Cited, predecessor, or same-author problem-family assets under a distinct semantic identifier.
problem_evidence_tiers.P3_DECLARED_PROXY: A documented external or synthetic problem carrying the required mathematical structure.
problem_evidence_tiers.P4_FORMULA_FIXTURE: Scalar or unit fixtures only; no optimization-quality claim.
